title: 化学と安全
subtitle: Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety
teachers:
TSUYUMOTO Isao
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Experiments play a major role in chemistry education and research. The curriculum for this course places great importance on experimentation and laboratory work. Because chemical experiments often involve handling dangerous substances and equipment, serious injury can result from mistakes in handling, often caused by a lack of knowledge. This course will provide the knowledge needed to perform chemical experiments safely.
advice:

activityGoals.body: Cite an example of an experimental accident and explain the cause.

              Experiments play a major role in chemistry education and research. The curriculum for this course places great importance on experimentation and laboratory work. Because chemical experiments often involve handling dangerous substances and equipment, serious injury can result from mistakes in handling, often caused by a lack of knowledge. This course will provide the knowledge needed to perform chemical experiments safely.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              1. Introduction (fundamentals of safety, safety first, Heinrich's law)
2. Classification of dangerous chemical compounds (such as explosives, combustibles, RI) and their safe handling
3. Electric safety
4. Examples of serious accidents
5. Laws on dangerous chemical substances and their compliance obligations
